g.text: the one spare room: a desk under the north window, a bed for visitors
on the west service shaft, as drawn
guest room, guest bath and the living room meet here
open to the dining across a bowed counter
washing, drying and the deep shelves
one room for all three: the adults south, the child's end north behind
the arched threshold into the family wing
on the south-east shaft, entered from the bedroom
one room from the front door to the balcony, read through three arches
imported from the builder's DWG · 1073 sq ft RERA
